scope: All 75 migrated issues: every description, title, type, status, priority, label, assignee, reporter, parent, link, comment, attachment count, estimate, date and resolution. Existing destination issue: original identity/title/type/status/labels plus write ledgers exclude it.

empty_fields_query.jql: project = FUCQ AND key != FUCQ-1 AND (cf[10016] IS NOT EMPTY OR cf[10015] IS NOT EMPTY OR duedate IS NOT EMPTY)

description_normalization: Semantic HTML tokens retain text, marks, links, headings, lists, task states and code. Ignores server-generated node IDs and equivalent default ordered-list/code-language attributes.
